title: audit_watch_snapshot v1
description: The auditd watches the manager asked for and whether they are loaded. Paths in audit_watches of the group configuration the engine writes (op.exp.3 P-04) get two watches, one per permission (w, a), with keys oscompliance_write and oscompliance_attr. Paths in read_watches (op.acc.2 P-06, op.acc.3 P-03 and the security paths, op.acc.4 P-07, op.exp.10 P-02) get four, one per permission (r, w, x, a), with keys oscompliance_read, oscompliance_write, oscompliance_exec and oscompliance_attr; the read rule only fires for sessions with a login UID (auid!=-1). Each access carries its kind. The agent loads a missing watch with auditctl and never removes one. Binaries in exec_watches (op.acc.3 P-03) get one execution watch each, key oscompliance_exec.

auditd.description: running; stopped (the daemon is not running or the kernel audit is off); absent (auditctl not installed); error.

loaded.description: Wanted paths whose watches are all loaded.

failed.description: Wanted paths whose watch could not be loaded, with the reason.

read_wanted.description: Wanted paths whose reads are audited (read_watches).

exec_wanted.description: Binaries whose executions the manager asked to audit (exec_watches).

exec_loaded.description: exec_wanted binaries whose execution watch is loaded.

perm_rules.description: Rules loaded with the key oscompliance_perm: changes of mode, owner and attributes by people (auid 1000 and above) and writes to /etc/group, /etc/gshadow, /etc/sudoers and /etc/sudoers.d. The agent loads them when none is.
